terra.problem: The verses appear to cover at least two places named Ophrah. The card describes only Gideon’s Ophrah, while Joshua 18:23 names a city in Benjamin. The card or verse grouping should distinguish them; 1 Samuel 13:17 may refer to the Benjaminite city.
Words such as “threshed,” “winepress,” “ephod,” and “snare” may be unfamiliar to fifth-grade readers. Brief explanations or simpler wording would make the moments easier to understand.
